reason: CLI owns item/library/doctor surfaces and the pre-dev checklist for command changes.
Place new read routing and clap flags in the existing command modules.
Keep local SQLite, desktop HTTP, and remote clients behind the existing context boundary.
Map busy, identity mismatch, 404, disabled API, and missing PDF to ZotError envelopes.
Add clap parse tests and JSON contract tests for the new read routes.
Connector stays import-only; doctor must keep connector and local HTTP capabilities distinct from item reads.
Reuse the Zotero 10 local client without sending write authorization on ordinary GETs.
Open-library route, identity binding, error matrix, and PDF file URL contract.
Human and JSON output must not leak library identifiers, credentials, or document text.
Snapshot reads, search, and PDF extraction stay owned by zot-local.
Do not move PDF extraction or search out of their existing modules.
Source zotero.sqlite stays read-only; snapshot consistency tests must keep working.
Map rusqlite busy, filesystem, and Pdfium failures without inventing zero values.
Title, journal, tag, and citation-key search need the existing search test invariants.
New read-route error codes and envelope fields belong in zot-core.
Better BibTeX item.search stays in zot-remote and must not grow CLI parsing.
BBT JSON-RPC failures stay remote errors and must not fall through to another library.
Allow only the read-only item.search method and cover it with the existing network-test patterns.
One command must keep a single library identity across cli, desktop, local, and remote.
Reuse the loopback client, DTO mapping, attachment picker, and Pdfium path.
